svg.title: goPool benchmark heat map
svg.desc: Heat map of mining.submit and mining.notify benchmark results from the August 15, 2026 rerun using the production profile. Each numeric metric column is colored independently; failed cells are labeled explicitly.
svg.text: Production Profile · rerun August 15, 2026. Green is better; red is worse.
* WarpPool's stock Enterprise profile has a 4,096-connection hard cap.
Colors use a logarithmic scale so outliers do not flatten the panels.
